title: The bus arriving
logline: The bus coming down 101 toward the depot at 4:08 with its headlights on, drawn from the bench's point of view. Two minutes of a morning he wasn't at. The page gives it the whole width.

panels.composition: From a depot bench: a bus coming down a dark coastal highway with its headlights on, still distant, the road wet, the sea black beside it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, from a bus depot bench, a bus coming down a dark coastal highway with its headlights on still distant, wet road and black sea beside it, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Two minutes of a morning he wasn't at.
